note: Target shortlist is a conditional architecture/research target, not evidence-ready promises. Three runtime entries including limited Shock Powder plus eight remaining candidates; Phase 2-2E found zero endgame promotion-ready candidates, so Artifact promotion is paused while Armor becomes the next subsystem.
scoreMeaning: Implementation priority judgment, not game strength or measured probability. Each dimension 1–5; high complexity/feedback/targeting scores are costs. Scores order research work, never override blockers.

nextPhaseDecision.reason: Phase 2-2E exhausted the bounded public source routes and found zero endgame Limited-ready Artifacts; all six candidates still lack a current high-Power basis or major unit/interaction semantics.

alternatives.dependencies: at least two current 1.17 endgame-ready Artifact candidates
